message.content: {"summary":"A strong Part 1 submission. Your mission concept for Great Barrier Reef bleaching monitoring is clear, well-justified and well-referenced, and your Gantt chart shows a detailed weekly plan. To reach the top band, formalise mission requirements, add contingency planning, present preliminary STK results, and adopt a professional referencing style.","next_steps":["Add a formal requirements section (goals, objectives, requirements) linking each requirement to user needs, and address orbit/coverage feasibility for your near-real-time relay claim (e.g. LEO revisit gaps vs GEO).","Add contingency/variation provisions to your project plan (e.g. buffer weeks, fallback tasks if STK simulations slip) and briefly justify End-of-Life options with technical screening.","Include preliminary technical results from STK (orbit plots, coverage/revisit figures) with brief interpretation, and replace footnote URLs with a formal reference list cited consistently in text."],"criteria":{"C1":"Your Mission Concept & Rationale clearly states the purpose (GBR bleaching monitoring), identifies users (marine and conservation scientists), and supports the rationale with cited literature on bleaching, reef scale and Asner's imaging technique — well into the Accomplished band. To consolidate this level, formalise mission goals, objectives and requirements, and discuss the orbit/coverage implications of your near-real-time relay claim.","C2":"Your Gantt chart with weekly tasks, colour-coded status, deadlines and task-by-task narrative tied to mission needs is detailed and credible. The Accomplished descriptor also requires provision for variations and contingencies, which is currently missing — adding schedule-slippage contingencies and technical screening of End-of-Life options would secure the top of the band.","C3":"Your progress evidence is background research and STK tutorials 1–4, which sits in the Adequate band. The Accomplished level requires a preliminary set of results with brief description or interpretation — include early STK outputs (e.g. orbit or coverage figures) and interpret them to show technical progress.","C4":"Your report is well-written with clear headings and a good Gantt figure, but referencing is informal: bare URLs as footnotes, no formal reference list, inconsistent in-text citation, and an informal 'Useful Links' section. Adopting a consistent citation style with a matching reference list would lift presentation to the Accomplished level."}}
